description: Evaluate unmodified Splash 1.4.0 with BF16 target KV instead of the base INT8 KV using all eight Full endpoint-bench tests. The base Full report measured 2889.9 prefill tokens/s at 10K and 1952.2 at 50K with INT8 KV; prior native controls suggest BF16 may reduce prefill throughput. Measure the complete endpoint workflow and retain all quality regressions. Preserve the target MLX affine 8-bit checkpoint, DFlash2 draft, FP32 recurrent state, default reasoning and automatic verification, automatic memory/context planning, temporary SSD prefix caching, language-only mode and idle release off. Pass --kv-format bf16 explicitly. Record any resulting automatic context or expert-memory changes; do not treat this system configuration comparison as an isolated kernel benchmark. Pin the current released evaluator.
